units.intro_es: Meet Simon, Stella and Suzy and their dog Dotty. We say our name and our age, count from one to twenty, name colours and toys, and say where things are.

units.intro_es: Stella shows her family tree: grandparents, parents, Uncle Fred and Aunt May. We describe people, say what they like doing and what they want to do, and practise the er sound.

concepts.es_text: Hi! I'm Aunt May. Stella's reading. She enjoys reading about science. She's clever and she wants to be a doctor. Simon's wearing his helmet because he's riding his bike. Grandma's quiet. She enjoys painting. Rule: after like, love and enjoy the verb ends in -ing; after want to we use the verb.

concepts.es: What do they look like? Appearance
concepts.es_text: My aunt is tall. She's got black hair. Aunt May's a doctor, she's got straight black hair. Uncle Fred's a farmer, his beard is short and fair. Grandma is quiet, she wants to paint all day. Grandpa is funny, and his curly hair is grey. Simon can be naughty, he loves Lock and Key. His sister Stella's clever, and she doesn't like TV. Suzy isn't quiet, but she's very small. Here's our family, we really love them all.
concepts.hu_text: A nagynéném magas. Fekete haja van. May néni orvos, egyenes fekete haja van. Fred bácsi gazda, a szakálla rövid és szőke. Nagymama csendes, egész nap festeni akar. units.intro_es: A day has a morning, an afternoon, an evening and a night. We wake up, get dressed, catch the bus and do our homework. We say the time and the days of the week. How often do you do things? Always, sometimes or never? We also read about an astronaut's day in space.

concepts.es_text: When the verb ends in s, the ending has three sounds. After eat, wake, sit: the s sounds like s. After play, fly, sing: the s sounds like z. concepts.hu_text: Az ige végi s-nek három hangja lehet. Az eat, wake, sit után az s olyan, mint a szisz hang. A play, fly, sing után az s olyan, mint a z. units.intro_es: What's the matter? I've got a headache. We talk about illnesses: a cold, a cough, an earache, a toothache, a stomach-ache and a temperature. We say who has got what, what we must do and what we mustn't do. We move our bodies: swim, skip, hop, jump, run, climb and dance. We also read about home remedies.
units.intro_hu: Mi a baj? Fáj a fejem. Betegségekről beszélünk: megfázás, köhögés, fülfájás, fogfájás, hasfájás és láz. Megmondjuk, kinek mije van, mit kell és mit nem szabad csinálnunk. Mozgunk: úszunk, ugrókötelezünk, szökdelünk, ugrálunk, futunk, mászunk és táncolunk. A házi gyógymódokról is olvasunk.

units.intro_es: Animals of the world: bat, bear, dolphin, jellyfish, kangaroo, lion, panda, parrot, penguin, shark and whale. Where do they live? What have they got? What can they do? concepts.es: Comparatives: bigger, quicker, better, worse
concepts.es_text: A whale is bigger than a penguin. A dolphin is smaller than a whale. A lion is quicker than a panda. An elephant is dirtier than a bat. Most adjectives: add er (long – longer). Adjectives with one vowel + one consonant: double the letter (big – bigger). Adjectives ending in y: y becomes ier (dirty – dirtier). Irregular: good – better, bad – worse.
concepts.hu_text: A bálna nagyobb, mint a pingvin. A delfin kisebb, mint a bálna. Az oroszlán gyorsabb, mint a panda. Az elefánt piszkosabb, mint a denevér. A legtöbb melléknév: er-t kap (long – longer). Egy magánhangzó + egy mássalhangzó végződés: megkettőzzük a betűt (big – bigger). Y-ra végződő melléknév: az y ier lesz (dirty – dirtier). Rendhagyó: good – better, bad – worse.

units.intro_es: What's the weather like? It's sunny, cloudy, windy, rainy or snowy. Our friends are on holiday and they write postcards. We say what we wear: a coat, a hat, gloves, a scarf, a sweater, a T-shirt and swim shorts. Yesterday it was cold. Today it is hot. We use was and were for yesterday. We also learn about the sounds of nature and musical instruments.
units.intro_hu: Milyen az idő? Napos, felhős, szeles, esős vagy havas. A barátaink nyaralnak és képeslapot írnak. Megmondjuk, mit viselünk: kabátot, sapkát, kesztyűt, sálat, pulóvert, pólót és fürdőnadrágot. Tegnap hideg volt. Ma meleg van. A tegnapra a was és a were szót használjuk. A természet hangjairól és a hangszerekről is tanulunk.

concepts.es: Music: What does nature sound like?
concepts.es_text: Nature makes sounds: animals, birds, rain and thunder. Some instruments sound like nature. A rain stick comes from Chile and sounds like rain. A vuvuzela comes from South Africa and sounds like elephants. A didgeridoo comes from Australia and sounds like Australian birds. A sea organ is an instrument that you don't need to play: the waves make the music. An invitation tells us what, where and when.
concepts.hu_text: A természet hangokat ad: állatok, madarak, eső és mennydörgés. Néhány hangszer úgy szól, mint a természet. Az esőbot Chiléből származik, és esőhangot ad. A vuvuzela Dél-Afrikából származik, és elefántra emlékeztet. A didzseridu Ausztráliából származik, és ausztrál madarakra emlékeztet. A tengeri orgona olyan hangszer, amin nem kell játszani: a hullámok zenélnek rajta. A meghívó megmondja: mi, hol és mikor.
